spec.description: Java agent JVM monitoring across overview, memory/GC, and execution detail. Covers all current JVM metric families. Service and instance labels match the WildFly collection diagnostics.

### Know where the JVM spends its budget
JVM / RUNTIME · **IyziTrace** · Prometheus

Heap pressure, CPU demand and collection pauses. Summary values follow Service and Instance. Explore the allocation curve and thread states in the detail tabs.
